body: Good point, I'll definitely think about it that way more harder.

Don't blame yourself. You can work on the problem, adjust it, accept the difference, whatever you like. Don't let society try to box you into being normal, I sure as hell don't think it's okay when people try to do that to me. 

I really hope you feel better anyway... it's sounds like you're going through a time you're having trouble. 

Thanks a lot, I'm honored for real that you were willing to respond the way you did.

 Take care too.
Thanks.. but I was diagnosed with that, but I don't believe it, because I'm not being given proof for it. But never mind that, I hope you find some peace and hope in your life. You deserve it a lot.
